semanticVerification.evidence: line 121 createGitHubMachineRuntime({ userData: dataRoot, crypto: platform secureStorage }); line 128 `if (!runtime.configured) blockedExternal(...)`; line 157 new GitHubAppPromotionCredentialProvider(runtime.auth). Resolves from the host data root's vault, not from the environment.
lines 180-183: `if (localBase !== liveBase.value.sha) fail([...refusing to build a Candidate on a base the acceptance cannot vouch for])`. The candidate base must equal the LIVE protected tip.

line 189 acceptancePath = `electron/credential-boundary/live-acceptance-${stamp}.md` — under electron/credential-boundary/, a Root-Surface-protected path. Lines 196-198 document that it is deliberately inert and NEVER merged, chosen so the promotion path stops at WAITING_FOR_ROOT_OWNER with every required check green.

line 275 `await adapter.readRequiredCheck(candidateHeadSha)` — checks are read for the exact candidate SHA; line 295 fails if `checks.status !== "OK"`. Line 271 passes `{ ciWaitMs: 45 * 60_000 }` into promoteCandidateOverGitHub, i.e. the bounded wait that the pre-city round recorded as absent on main@1d78ee67.

line 293 `if (result.outcome !== "WAITING_FOR_ROOT_OWNER") failures.push(...)`; line 294 independently requires `record.state === "WAITING_FOR_ROOT_OWNER"` — both the controller outcome and the durable record must agree.
lines 277 and 289: reads the base branch SHA after the run and computes `protectedBranchUnmoved`; line 298 fails if the protected branch moved.
line 299 `if (record.rootOwnerApproval) failures.push("a Root Owner approval exists for this SHA; the acceptance may not create one")`.

The module documents (lines 41-43) that it never merges, never touches a ruleset/protection/secret/tag, never reads an Owner credential and never writes a token into evidence; mergePullRequest is wired as a handler (line 229) but the change set is Root-Surface so the promotion path itself refuses. The negative outcomes above are the enforcement.

preflight.evidence: Identity resolution and the `!runtime.configured` guard run at lines 121-144, i.e. BEFORE any candidate creation (line 187), commit (line 200), push or PR. The preflight branch at lines 254-259 reports PREFLIGHT_PASS and exits 0 with the comment 'nothing was pushed'. Therefore with no credential the process exits BLOCKED_EXTERNAL (exit 2) without any remote mutation.

main_instrument_limitations.cannotProveEvidence: The only promotion-related call in the module is createPullRequest (line 71). There is no reference anywhere in the file to WAITING_FOR_ROOT_OWNER, rootOwnerApproval, mergePullRequest, or readRequiredCheck.
main_instrument_limitations.classificationReason: Its declared base branch feature/github-machine-identity does not exist on the remote, so its first step (base branch inspect, line 50, wrapped in requireOk) cannot succeed; and even if it did, it exercises PR creation only and cannot demonstrate the authority ceiling. main was NOT modified to make this legacy acceptance runnable.
main_instrument_limitations.historicalNote: It DID work once: docs/github-machine-identity-acceptance.md records it creating acceptance/github-machine-identity-20260911015734 and PR #3 as actor codex-boss[bot], when that base branch existed.

conclusion: The PF020 live-promotion-acceptance instrument is valid and matches its declared semantics; the general main-branch machine acceptance is not a substitute for it. The credential ceremony is the only remaining external precondition.
